name: Push Chain – Season 3 Rewards
reward: Points & Rare Passes; tokenomics propose 10% of $PC supply for airdrops (per airdrop.promo)
summary: Final incentivized testnet season before mainnet. Points come from on-chain use of universal apps.
steps: Open the Push Chain rewards portal and log in with socials or a wallet
Complete on-chain quests (swap, LP, play, predict) to earn XP
Hit the daily Spin 2 Win and level up to collect Rare Passes
Optional: refer friends with your link

name: Quip Points
reward: QP convert to $QUIP at TGE by leaderboard position; 10% of initial supply for community programs
summary: Points for using the quantum-safe wallet, QuipSwap, and running nodes.
steps: Link your Quip wallet's parent wallet to X and follow @quipnetwork
Sign in daily at accounts.quip.network (up to 5 QP/day)
Swap on QuipSwap (5 QP per swap, up to 15/day)
Optional: run a node or refer friends

name: Quip Quest & Mindshare campaigns
summary: Older Quip campaigns still listed as Live, each with its own leaderboard.
steps: Open points.quip.network and scroll to 'All points campaigns'
Join the Quest and/or Mindshare campaign from its own site

name: Vearl – Public Testnet #1 (mining)
reward: Team commits 0.7% of max mainnet supply to eligible miners of this testnet, by points
summary: Testnet opened Oct 23, 2026 16:00 UTC (21:30 IST). Points come only from blocks you mine; be active on 3+ different days and register your address.
steps: Install the Vearl miner from the official participate page
Mine with your own address on at least 3 different days
Register your address with a signature
Never share your 24 words – the team will never ask
